nodes.description: ZethrInterface instance pointing at the external Zethr token contract 0xD48B...020D; target of external calls.
Address that receives contract balance in sendDivsToBankroll; mutable by owner via changeBankroll.
Owner address initialized from msg.sender at deployment; access-control anchor for privileged functions.
Payable public function that measures balance before/after an external buyAndTransfer call and emits onTokenPurchase.
Payable fallback function that accepts plain ETH transfers with no logic.
Owner-only function that rewrites the bankroll address.
Owner-only function that forwards the entire contract balance to bankroll via transfer.
Caller-controlled address used for the owner check, token balance queries and as the buy target.
Low-level external payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value)(...) executed before the post-balance is read.
bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the whole contract balance to an arbitrary stored address.
Unsigned subtraction balanceAfter - balanceBefore used to compute tokens minted; underflows if the post-balance is smaller.
Referrer address supplied by the caller and forwarded unchanged to the external buyAndTransfer call.
uint8 dividend-rate selector supplied by the caller and forwarded to the external buyAndTransfer call.
New bankroll address provided by the owner, written into the bankroll state variable without validation.
zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) snapshot taken before the external call.
zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) snapshot taken after the external call; sole source for the minted-amount math.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable at deployment, defining the privileged identity.
msg.sender is used inside buyTokensWithProperEvent for balanceOf queries and as the buy target.
changeBankroll is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
sendDivsToBankroll is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender is passed as the target argument of the external buyAndTransfer call.
The zethr interface instance is read for balanceOf before and after the purchase.
The zethr contract address is the callee of the external buyAndTransfer call.
buyTokensWithProperEvent executes the external buyAndTransfer call while holding the whole msg.value.
The external callee can re-enter buyTokensWithProperEvent before the post-balance is captured.
sendDivsToBankroll performs the bankroll.transfer external value transfer.
The receiving bankroll address can re-enter sendDivsToBankroll while the balance is still being sent.
sendDivsToBankroll reads the bankroll state variable as the transfer recipient.
changeBankroll writes the bankroll state variable.
Caller-supplied _referredBy is forwarded unchanged into the external buyAndTransfer call.
Caller-supplied divChoice is forwarded unchanged into the external buyAndTransfer call.
Owner-supplied _newBankroll is assigned to the bankroll state variable without validation.
balanceBefore is the subtrahend operand of the balanceAfter - balanceBefore computation.
balanceAfter is the minuend operand; if smaller than balanceBefore the unsigned subtraction underflows.
buyTokensWithProperEvent performs the unsigned balance difference that may underflow.
balanceBefore is captured before the external call and therefore reflects pre-call state.
balanceAfter is captured after the external call, so the callee can manipulate the measured delta.
